reuse.why: The rule change goes into the existing isMonthFillCategory and getMonthFillCategories, which all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: The only repeat is the 'c.goal_def IS NOT NULL AS has_template' column, which has to appear in both the budget-data and the category queries that feed the shared predicate.

placement.why: The exclusion is decided in the shared month-fill predicate in actions.ts, and the queries only supply the data it needs.

scope.why: The change covers the predicate, the two feeding queries, setZero's scope, tests and a release note, all part of the request.

maintainability.why: The predicate stays small and documented, and dropping the obsolete 'all' scope simplifies it. The remaining 'copyable' vs 'visible' difference (missing group row) is named in the comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the averages all go through isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Nothing is duplicated in disguise; the has_template column appears in two queries only because each data source needs it.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden / hidden-group / has_template rule, and every month-wide action goes through it.
